title: My First Day at Magic School

paragraphs.en: It was my first day at the Magic Academy, and I was both excited and nervous.
paragraphs.cn: 这是我在魔法学院的第一天，我既兴奋又紧张。

paragraphs.en: The school building looked like an ancient castle with tall towers and mysterious windows.
paragraphs.cn: 学校建筑看起来像一座古老的城堡，有高高的塔楼和神秘的窗户。

paragraphs.en: My teacher, Professor Moon, welcomed us with a warm smile and a wave of her wand.
paragraphs.cn: 我的老师，月亮教授，用温暖的微笑和挥舞魔杖欢迎我们。

paragraphs.en: She told us that learning magic requires patience, practice, and courage.
paragraphs.cn: 她告诉我们学习魔法需要耐心、练习和勇气。

paragraphs.en: I knew that this year would be an unforgettable adventure.
paragraphs.cn: 我知道这一年将是一次难忘的冒险。
